name: hope-capital-siege
reviewNotes: All 19 original glyph records reviewed, including repeated gate checks and Ginji's return branch.
Tributes are a bride's appearance, a cherry tree and a golden Buddha statue; retain all three clues.
Merchant glyph bytes 1962 1963 1983 read 蜂乃屋, independently checked in the resident and negotiation blocks.

「阿修羅帶著，

「阿修羅自幼，
